name: core.openwop.connections.tiktok-ads
description: TikTok Ads connection pack (RFC 0095) — OAuth2 provider for the TikTok Business (Marketing) API. Reach is `openapi`: the manifest declares the TikTok business-api OAuth hosts and points at the Marketing API reference. Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the app id/secret host-side. The third ad platform Campaign Studio dispatches to — TikTok authenticates with an `Access-Token` header (not `Authorization: Bearer`), handled host-side by the ads-dispatch adapter.
